source_text: [and]-yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ | tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati | nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ | sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca | na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ yataḥ karaṇavargo 'yaṃ vimūḍho 'mūḍhavat svayam | sahāntareṇa cakreṇa pravṛttisthitisaṃhṛtiḥ labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt | yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā na hīcchānodanasyāyam prerakatvena vartate | api tv ātmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ | yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah | yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca
raw_fragment: [and]-yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ
literal_gloss: yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ

source_text: [and]-tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam | kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam | tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī | nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt | labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ

[and]-aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ | pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye | jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan | dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati | tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati tām aśrityordhvamārgeṇa candrasūryāv ubhāv api | sauṣumne 'dhvanyastamito hitvā brahmā.ṅdagocaram tadā tasmin mahāvyomni pralīnaśaśibhāskare | sauṣuptapadavan mūḍhaḥ prabuddhaḥ syād anāvṛtaḥ dvitīyo niḥṣyandaḥ tadākramya balam mantrāḥ sarvajñābalaśālinaḥ | pravartante 'dhikārāya karaṇānīva dehinām tatraiva sampralīyante śāntarūpā nirañjanāḥ | sahārādhakacittena tenaite śivadharmiṇaḥ yasmāt sarvamayo jīvaḥ sarvabhāvasamudbhavāt | tatsaṃvedanarūpeṇa tādātmyapratipattitaḥ

[and]-tasmāc chabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ | bhoktaiva bhogyabhāvena sadā sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ iti vā yasya saṃvittiḥ krīḍātvenākhilaṃ jagat | sa paśyan satataṃ yukto jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ ayam evodayas tasya dhyeyasya dhyāyicetasi | tadātmatāsamāpattir icchataḥ sādhakasya yā iyam evāmṛtaprāptir ayam evātmano grahaḥ | iyaṃ nirvāṇa-dīkṣā ca śivasadbhāvadāyini tṛtīyo niḥṣyandaḥ yathecchābhyarthito dhātā jāgrato 'rthān hṛdi sthitān somasūryodayaṃ kṛtvā sampādayati dehinaḥ || 1 | tathā svapne 'py abhīṣṭārthān praṇayasyānatikramāt | nityaṃ sphuṭataraṃ madhye sthito 'vaśyaṃ prakāśayet anyathā tu svatantrā syāt sṛṣṭis taddharmakatvataḥ | satataṃ laukikasyeva jāgratsvapnapadadvaye yathā hi artho 'sphuṭo dṛṣṭaḥ sāvadhāne 'pi cetasi | bhūyaḥ sphuṭataro bhāti svabalodyogabhāvitaḥ tathā yat paramārthena yena yatra yathā sthitam | tat tathā balam ākramya na cirāt sampravartate durbalo 'pi tadākramya yataḥ kārye pravartate | ācchādayed bubhukṣāṃ ca tathā yo 'ti bubhukṣitaḥ
raw_fragment: [and]-tasmāc chabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ
literal_gloss: tasmāc chabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ

source_text: [and]-anenādhiṣṭhite dehe yathā sarvajñatādayaḥ | tathā svātmany adhiṣṭhānāt sarvatraivam bhaviṣyati glānir vilu.ṅthikā dehe tasyāścājñānataḥ sṛtiḥ | tad unmeṣaviluptaṃ cet kutaḥ sā syād ahetukā ekacintāprasaktasya yataḥ syād aparodayaḥ | unmeṣaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ svayaṃ tam upalakṣayet ato bindur ato nādo rūpam asmād ato rasaḥ | pravartante 'cireṇaiva kṣobhakatvena dehinaḥ didṛkṣayeva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate | tadā kiṃ bahunoktena svayam eva avabhotsyate prabuddhaḥ sarvadā tiṣṭhej jñānenālokya gocaram | ekatrāropayet sarvaṃ tato 'nyena na pīḍyate śabdarāśisamutthasya śaktivargasya bhogyatām | kalāviluptavibhavo gataḥ san sa paśuḥ smṛtaḥ parāmṛtarasāpāyas tasya yaḥ pratyayodbhavaḥ | tenāsvatantratām eti sa ca tanmātragocaraḥ svarūpāvaraṇe cāsya śaktayaḥ satatotthitāḥ | yataḥ śabdānuvedhena na vinā pratyayodbhavaḥ

[and]-seyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī | bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñāta siddhyupapādikā tanmātrodayarūpena mano 'haṃbuddhivartinā | puryaṣṭakena saṃruddhas taduttham pratyayodbhavam bhuṅkte paravaśo bhogaṃ tadbhāvāt saṃsared ataḥ | saṃsṛtipralayasyāsya kāraṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe yadā tv ekatra saṃrūḍhas tadā tasya layodayau | niyacchan bhoktṛtām eti tataś cakreśvaro bhavet caturtho niḥṣyandaḥ agādhasaṃśayāmbhodhisamuttaraṇatārinīm | vande vicitrārthapadāṃ citrāṃ tāṃ gurubhāratīm labdhvāpy alabhyam etaj jñānadhanaṃ hṛdguhāntakṛtanihiteḥ | vasuguptavac chivāya hi bhavati sadā sarvalokasya
